newsitem.title: USA: Highland Federal sees gain from branch sale.
newsitem.headline: Highland Federal sees gain from branch sale.

text.p: Highland Federal Bank said Wednesday it had entered into a definitive agreement to sell one of its branches and expects to recognize a one-time gain of about $800,000.
Highland said in a news release that the branch, located in Woodland Hills, Calif., is to be sold to a financial institution.
This latest agreement brings to four the total number of Highland's branches sold or subject to definitive sales agreements following the sale of three others in first quarter 1997, the release said.
The sale of the branch is expected to encompass about $39 million of retail deposits which will be settled for cash, the release said.
Highland said it expected ongoing savings of general and administrative expenses to outweigh incremental funding costs.
The sale of this branch is expected to close in the third quarter of 1997, the company said.
